comment: What a kind of site changes about the ORDER of a report, never about a number. A kind moves the findings it leads with up one severity level (never to critical) and the ones it defers down two - further, because a deferred signal is one whose points lost are inflated by the kind not fitting. The usual order then applies. Blocking findings are never listed and never moved. The same judgements are written out for the model in skills/audit/sections/site-kind.md, and a test holds every id here to its paragraph there.

docs.label: a documentation or reference site
docs.note: A reference page is read one section at a time and an engine lifts one section, so answer-first writing, structure and an llms.txt count for more here, and per-page authorship for less.

spec.label: a specification or standard
spec.note: Authority comes from the document being the standard rather than from a byline, so structure, stated evidence, schema coverage and an llms.txt count for more here, and per-page authorship for less.

publisher.label: a publisher or blog
publisher.note: An engine choosing between two accounts of the same event picks the one it can date and attribute, so authorship and freshness count for more here.

saas.label: a SaaS or marketing site
saas.note: Marketing prose is where unsupported claims and paragraphs that only make sense in sequence concentrate, and the brand has to resolve to an entity, so self-contained passages, stated evidence and organisation markup count for more here. Marketing pages do not carry bylines, so per-page authorship counts for less.

ecommerce.label: an ecommerce catalogue
ecommerce.note: Product and offer markup is what gets a catalogue into an answer at all, so schema coverage and valid markup count for more here. A product page has no author, so per-page authorship counts for less.

local.label: a local business
local.note: A local business has to resolve to one place with one name and one address, so organisation markup and consistent brand details count for more here, and per-page authorship for less.
